question: When can a frozen prismatic B-Rep evidence a nested-cylinder and planar-shoulder relation?

measurement.scope: exactly two +Z cylindrical faces in the frozen prismatic counterbore geometry
measurement.matched: Two coaxial cylinders with strictly ordered radii share exactly one adjacent planar face.
measurement.fail_closed: All other cylinder counts, axes, radii or shared-planar cardinalities are unsupported.

boundaries: This reports a geometry relation, not a counterbore feature label.
Only the frozen +Z two-cylinder scope is supported.
No original history, generic recognition, public probe/runtime helper, manifest or provider use follows.

runtime_projection.review_trigger: Independent direct runtime evidence and a separate adoption review are required.
